catDesc.machines: Desktop CNC milling and engraving machine for workshops and small-scale production: wood, plywood, acrylic, PVC, aluminium and non-ferrous metals.
catDesc.spindle: High-speed electric spindle for CNC milling and engraving machines. It is driven by a VFD (frequency inverter); the power, collet and cooling type are listed in the specifications.
catDesc.kits: A ready-made kit for building or upgrading a CNC router: a spindle and a matching VFD (frequency inverter).
catDesc.vfd: Frequency inverter (VFD) for high-speed CNC spindles: smooth start and speed control up to 400 Hz.
catDesc.lasers: Laser equipment for engraving, cutting and marking. The laser power, working area and supported materials are listed in the specifications.
catDesc.co2: Spare part for CO2 laser cutting and engraving machines: replacement and repair of worn components.
catDesc.drives: Axis drive for CNC machines: the motor position is controlled by an encoder, so steps are not lost under load.
catDesc.controllers: Control system for CNC machines: runs G-code programs and controls the axis drives and the spindle.
catDesc.rotary: Rotary axis (4th axis) for CNC milling machines: machining of cylindrical workpieces such as balusters, figures and handles.
catDesc.mechanics: Mechanical components for building and upgrading CNC machines.
catDesc.tools: Cutting tool for CNC milling machines.
